cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wrote my name in the margin like you. Contribution logged. Put 'roof repaired by Pat' in the village minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was testing a new pen. We all know you fixed it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pen ready. The minutes weren't there with a ladder; they need telling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We'll thank you at the party.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After the roof line, write 'thanks pending' so we remember.
